source_reviews.rationale: Lock delta is limited to body-parser 2.3.0→2.4.0, its content-type 2.0.0→2.1.0, follow-redirects 1.16.0→1.16.2, qs 6.16.0→6.17.0, and Zod 3.25.76→4.6.7; no package nodes removed. Compression tests cover ordinary request compatibility and resolution, not an advisory crash reproduction.

Only body-parser ^2.4.0 and root Zod 4.6.7 dependency requirements change; scripts and application topology are unchanged. Root Zod migration includes prior reviewed default, omission, record, function and error-path compatibility work.

Only validation error accessor changes to issues. Status/envelope keys remain; Zod 4 details codes/fields/messages are an explicitly accepted wire change, not byte-identical compatibility. AI handlers, persistence and auth are unchanged.

GUID validation preserves the prior non-version-specific identifier format; safe-parse and Zod type signatures migrate. Authorization, allocation mutations, decision operations and optimistic locking are unchanged.
prefault retains pre-transform string limit default and sort default; bounds remain 1–200. No listing, cursor, fund-scope or allocation write-path change.
Validation errors now use issues with accepted Zod 4 detail shape. Health-key guards and local-only invalidation/warming effects are unchanged.
Zod error accessor/type guard uses issues; exported validation details intentionally use Zod 4 shape/messages. Read-only calculation/export behavior and route registration are unchanged.

Pagination prefault preserves coercion/defaults. Update schema unwraps currency, status, quarterEnd and updatedAt defaults before partial, preserving omitted-field patch semantics. Transaction mutation/auth/delete semantics are unchanged.

Prefault preserves taxonomy/definition defaults; guid preserves accepted identifier format. Accepted Zod 4 details replace errors. Fund access, queries, mapping and definition write effects are unchanged.

Only scenario-set identifier uuid→guid validation changes locally; reviewed shared schemas retain provenance, domain refusal and transactional semantics. Existing fund scoping, optimistic locking and job boundaries remain.
Calculation fundSize prefault retains coercion, positivity, integer requirement and 100000000 default. Fund creation/read paths and authorization stay unchanged.

Forecast months now reuses domain integer range 3–60 with default 12, limiting per-request forecast-loop work. This is intentional request tightening. Transaction, expense and planned-investment arrays remain uncapped; exporting request schemas adds test access only. Endpoints remain read-only.

Prefault preserves optional query/report defaults; metadata record explicitly uses string keys. Array bounds, LP authorization inputs and report fields remain. No independently mapped surface is added.
Only first validation issue access changes; message content follows accepted Zod 4 defaults. LP access controls, report job/write effects and response envelopes are unchanged.
Prefault retains list limit; errors→issues repairs message access. LP authorization, cursor use, wire-instruction access logging and payment effects are unchanged.
Prefault retains list limit; first-error access uses issues. LP ownership, distribution reads and access logging are unchanged.
Prefault retains query/search limits, cursor GUID format retains prior acceptance and issues repairs validation messages. LP/document access controls, download effects and persistence remain.
Prefault preserves unreadOnly/limit; validation reads issues. Notification read/read-all/preferences mutations and LP auth remain unchanged.

Default limit still becomes string 50 then number 50 before pipe; required({limit:true}) reflects the already-present transformed output. Safe-parse type adapts to Zod 4. Idempotency parsing, import/actuals mutation and provenance controls are unchanged.

Prefault preserves simulation/batch defaults and guid keeps prior baseline-ID acceptance. Named schema export enables testing production schema instead of a divergent copy. Jobs, timeouts, concurrency settings and local-only exposure remain unchanged.
Only first validation issue accessor changes. Accepted default-message change does not alter fund authorization, metric query behavior, response status/envelope or writes.
prefault preserves runs and configured default fund ID parsing. Metrics handlers and local-only exposure remain unchanged.

Separate default-free base schema prevents partial strategy updates from injecting creation defaults. Create schemas reapply the original defaults with prefault; string-key records and guid preserve record/ID behavior. Prototype write blocks and local-only classification remain unchanged.

Record string keys and guid migrate compatible constraints/job IDs; issues changes accepted validation detail shape. Service, auth and job mutation boundaries are unchanged; no new mapped surface is added.

superRefine replaces removed dynamic refinement-message API and still rejects duplicate company IDs with the same duplicate list. Preview/commit distinction, allocation order, idempotency and optimistic locking are unchanged.
GUID format remains compatible and issues changes accepted validation detail shape. Scenario seed provenance, fund access, create/update/delete and optimistic-lock behavior remain.

prefault preserves restricted share defaults including LP hidden metrics; validation details use accepted Zod 4 shape. Management/public router distinction, passkeys, authorization, analytics and mutations remain.
prefault preserves query pagination, snapshot type, event and diff flags. Route/service behavior and reads-only classification remain unchanged.

Strategy-data record gains explicit string key schema; remaining changes are formatting. reserve_admin capability checks and sign/reject/approval mutation logic remain unchanged; no new mapped surface is added.

Only subscription/unsubscription entity UUID validation becomes compatible guid plus formatting. Origin/session/channel-fund authorization, socket setup and reachability remain unchanged. Shared source binding also affects the existing dev-dashboard row without altering its behavior.
